import math

def compute_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

a, b, limit = map(int, input().split())
divisor = compute_gcd(a, b)
a //= divisor
b //= divisor

if limit >= b:
    print(f"{a}/{b}")
else:
    ratio = a / b
    min_diff = ratio
    best_num = 0
    best_den = 1
    for i in range(1, limit + 1):
        val = i * ratio
        floor_val = math.floor(val)
        diff1 = abs(floor_val / i - ratio)
        diff2 = abs((floor_val + 1) / i - ratio)
        if min_diff > diff1 or min_diff > diff2:
            if diff1 > diff2:
                best_num = floor_val + 1
            else:
                best_num = floor_val
            best_den = i
            min_diff = min(diff1, diff2)
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
